overview.description: The Genter Capital Taxable Quality Intermediate ETF (GENT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed basket of taxable, intermediate-term fixed income instruments with investment grade rating. It seeks total return and current income from both US and foreign securities. GENT was launched on May 10, 2024 and is issued by Genter Capital.
